mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the two angled mirrors was the most worthwhile part: it showed the essential parts going into the tube, even if the text did not explain the light path.

leastWorthwhile.text: The repeated folds and flips became a little repetitive, although each had a clear construction purpose.

surprise.text: The flat sheet becoming a square tube was a satisfying transformation rather than a major surprise.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the goals and visible changes explained the sequence, though every combination was directed.

continue.text: I might continue to see another mechanism, but this chapter alone offered little choice. The text cannot tell me how the pictures or hands-on handling would feel.
